entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This petition is for granting leave to appeal against the  acquittal of the respondent vide order dated 03.08.2017 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mandsaur passed in Criminal Case No.2178/2011,
whereby the learned Trial Court has acquitted the accused from the charge under Section 7(1), read with 16(1)(A)(1) or 7 (iii) read with 16 (1)(A)(ii) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 for keeping and selling mis-branded or adulterated curd.
The main ground of acquittal is that the mandatory provision of Section 13(2) of the Act has not been complied with.
Admittedly, the intimation sent to the respondent by registered post received un-served and thereafter, no attempts have been made to intimate the respondent from whom the sample was taken by the Food Inspector.

Thus, the mandatory provisions are not complied with in its true sprit,
therefore, acquittal recorded by the learned Trial Court cannot be held illegal, incorrect or perverse.
Accordingly, no ground for leave to appeal is made out.
(Virender Singh) Judge sourabh The State Of Madhya Pradesh vs Nainsingh on 17 May, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133716644/
